Risk Description: Inactive or unnecessary user accounts remain enabled
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly account reviews and automate termination access removal
Perform quarterly privileged-access reviews and enforce least privilege

Risk Description: Suspicious activity is not identified because audit reviews are incomplete
Control Gap: Recurring log review evidence is inconsistent
Recommended Remediation: Establish recurring security log reviews and retain investigation evidence

Risk Description: Outdated secure configuration baselines introduce weaknesses
Control Gap: Baselines are not formally reviewed on a consistent schedule
Recommended Remediation: Review and approve secure configuration baselines annually

Risk Description: Untracked configuration exceptions create security exposure
Recommended Remediation: Create centralized configuration exception tracking with owners and due dates

Risk Description: Backup recovery fails during system disruption
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly restoration testing and document recovery results

Risk Description: Privileged account compromise due to incomplete MFA coverage
Existing Control: MFA is enabled for some privileged accounts
Control Gap: MFA is not enforced for all privileged accounts
Recommended Remediation: Require MFA for all privileged accounts and document approved exceptions

Risk Description: Remote access occurs without strong authentication
Existing Control: MFA is used for remote access
Control Gap: MFA coverage is not consistently validated
Recommended Remediation: Review MFA enrollment and enforce coverage for all applicable remote users

Risk Description: Incident response procedures fail during a real cybersecurity incident
Control Gap: Tabletop exercises are not performed consistently
Recommended Remediation: Conduct annual incident response tabletop exercises and track corrective actions

Risk Description: Known high-risk vulnerability is exploited before remediation
Existing Control: Vulnerability scanning and tracking are in place
Recommended Remediation: Enforce severity-based remediation SLAs and document risk acceptance for exceptions

Risk Description: High-risk supplier introduces unmanaged cybersecurity risk
Recommended Remediation: Perform annual security reassessments of high-risk suppliers and track findings

Risk Description: Risk assessment evidence cannot be produced efficiently during an audit
Control Gap: Evidence is fragmented across multiple locations
Recommended Remediation: Centralize risk assessment evidence and management review records
